referenceSource: muyifeng-atlas.png, explicitly selected by the user
productionMethod: Original PNG cutouts for head/front hair, back hair, robe and sleeves. The head/face are not regenerated, recolored or quantized. The torso mask removes embedded duplicate sleeves; each original sleeve is split into two overlapping source-pixel segments.
sourceInvariant: Runtime compares all 21,700 face-identity pixels and every retained opaque source-clothing texel, deduplicated by original atlas coordinates. Deliberately masked-out torso arms are not counted.
supplementaryMethod: Built-in image_gen.imagegen, referenced original art, genuine alpha. Used only for inner trouser legs, boots and a straight double-edged jian. Source atlas has some attached boot pixels in the leg cells; crop rectangles exclude those.
jointAdaptation: Original neck/waist landmarks set torso fit; the head shares the collar neck point. Reference shoulder/elbow/palm/sole proportions retarget native movement. Two-segment sleeves bend at the elbow with 50 source pixels of overlap and meet independent hand wrists. No flat backing paint is used. Feet share ankle landmarks with trouser legs; original game skeleton transforms remain unchanged.
weaponAdaptation: Only supplementary sword pixels are rotated -25 degrees into the native weapon axis. Its source handle grip is anchored to the same palm as the hand, and marked as equipment for body normalization. Equipment identity/stats and native bone transforms are unchanged; empty hands and non-blade equipment keep their native equipment state.
runtimeConversion: Face and clothing texture data keep original source pixels and Point filtering. Child renderers are positioned/rotated/scaled by shared landmarks, without modifying native bones. Only supplementary sword pixels use nearest-neighbor baked rotation. Native perceived-height normalization remains active.
previousMethod: 0.2–0.3 authored palette-grid faces were superseded after user feedback; their generator remains a legacy tool, not the current artwork authority.
referenceGenerationPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production LOW-RES PIXEL PAPER-DOLL SPRITE PARTS for an animated 2D game. Reference image is the APPROVED design direction; DO NOT shrink or copy its full-body illustration. Redraw purpose-built small pixel sprites with deliberate broad clusters, clean contour and high readability at 90px total game height.
Transparent square canvas, 3 columns by 3 rows of equal cells, generous transparent gutters, NO text, grid lines, checkerboard, scenery or cast shadow. All pieces belong to ONE Mu Yifeng-inspired male swordsman: calm confident youthful face, black tied hair, cyan jade ring, white robe, indigo blue wrap collar/sash, charcoal shoulder panels, pale blue-gray lower robe, dark boots. Three-quarter FRONT view facing RIGHT (the visible front is on image RIGHT), unified 3-head-tall chibi proportions; attractive angular expressive face, not a round generic doll.
CRITICAL medium: deliberately drawn game pixel art at a consistent ~32x40 logical pixel budget PER LARGE PIECE, enlarged as crisp square blocks. Finite ~20-color palette. NO smooth painting, anti-aliasing, noisy diagonal dither or hundreds of tiny details. Eye and eyebrow clusters MUST remain readable: dark slanted eyebrows, almond white eyes with dark pupils, short skin-shaded nose and single dark mouth line. Face colors warm ivory, peach and restrained brown shadow, not blank cream.
Nine cells, contents exactly:
ROW1 COL1: COMPLETE HEAD including face shape, both readable eyebrows/eyes, small nose/mouth, front bangs and top bun with jade ring. No neck or long ponytail. Approx 28x38 logical pixels. Face looking RIGHT, near visible eye slightly larger, cheek/jaw shaped; black fringe swept away from visible eye. Head and bun one coherent sprite.
ROW1 COL2: ONLY back hair / flowing ponytail, attached behind head at the upper-right, swept down-left. No face, skin, front bangs or bun. Simple 2-3 tapered dark locks, no spiky tangles.
ROW1 COL3: ONLY robe torso, no head, neck, sleeves, hands or legs. V wrap collar, white lapels around blue inner collar, narrow charcoal shoulder yoke, blue waist sash and one small jade clasp. Approx 26x28 logical pixels.
ROW2 COL1: one LEFT SLEEVE overlay, no hand/skin, shoulder attaches at top, white fabric with blue cuff and a small charcoal shoulder cap. Approx 14x18 logical pixels.
ROW2 COL2: matching RIGHT SLEEVE overlay, opposite silhouette, same size, no hand/skin.
ROW2 COL3: LEFT LOWER ROBE / trouser leg, pale white-blue cloth, indigo edge and a defined fold, no foot. Approx 12x22 logical pixels.
ROW3 COL1: RIGHT LOWER ROBE / trouser leg, matching opposite leg with simple asymmetrical indigo overlapping robe flap, no foot.
ROW3 COL2: LEFT BOOT only, dark slate blue-black, little pale highlight, foot facing RIGHT. Approx 8x12 logical pixels.
ROW3 COL3: RIGHT BOOT only, matching same direction/scale, approx 8x12 logical pixels.
Parts centered in their own cells with no overlap, designed for SPUM-style segmented bones with correct joint overlap. White sleeves and torso must be separately cut pieces, NOT duplicated assembled arms. Every part has honest transparent surroundings. Do not include a full-body figure anywhere.
handMethod: Built-in image_gen.imagegen, with approved original atlas as reference, transparent_background=true. Four compact independent hand sprites (gripping/relaxed, left/right). Only missing hands are supplemented; face/head/clothes are not generated.
